# AthenaBioLabs
> Indian supplier of research-grade peptides with ≥99% HPLC purity, third-party Janoshik Certificates of Analysis on every batch, and cold-chain express delivery across India. Research use only.

- [Delivery photos](https://www.athenabiolabs.com/proof): Customer delivery proof from across India

## Key facts
- Ships from within India; 2–4 day express delivery to all major Indian cities
- Every batch tested by Janoshik Analytical (independent lab): HPLC purity + mass spec
- QR-linked COA on every vial, verifiable on the lab's own site
- Payment via UPI, bank transfer or crypto, arranged on WhatsApp
- All products strictly for in-vitro laboratory research; not for human or animal use
- Contact: support@athenabiolabs.com
